subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining media batching work be implemented as a LINE/plugin-owned opt-in buffer, a generic channel SDK/gateway media coalescer, or deferred in favor of existing text debounce plus narrow channel bug fixes?
rationale: The remaining work changes turn boundaries, latency, config shape, and channel lifecycle semantics, so maintainer intent is needed before a safe fix lane can choose the owner boundary.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned media buffering
options.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in affected channel plugins first, reusing shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

options.title: Design a generic coalescer
options.body: Create a broader SDK or gateway coalescing contract before channel-specific implementation, accepting the larger API, compatibility, and docs review.

options.title: Defer broader batching
options.body: Keep current text debounce and Telegram album handling as supported behavior, and only handle narrow channel bugs such as the open WhatsApp steer media-loss path.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned media buffering
recommendation.body: Implement an opt-in sender/conversation-scoped media buffer in affected channel plugins first, reusing shared SDK helpers only where they clearly reduce duplication.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared debounce policy, plugin boundaries, and config compatibility, and history ties this owner to the shared policy surface.
